clue.text: Proscribe a woolly cap for 20 perhaps

parts.note: to proscribe something is to ban it
a tam (tam-o'-shanter) is a Scottish woolly bonnet

explanation.surface: Someone is told to forbid a knitted hat for a cockerel.
explanation.walkthrough: 20 refers to the answer at 20-across, a fighting cock; a bantam is a small breed of fowl, famous as a feisty fighter.
explanation.definitionFit: Bantams are a small domestic fowl breed, often used as game birds, so one is an example of the bird at 20.

clue.text: Boat isn't designed for a blooming expert

indicators.note: something designed is shaped anew, so the letters of the two words are rearranged

explanation.surface: A vessel is said not to be built for a gardening specialist.
explanation.walkthrough: 'designed' signals the anagram of BOAT and ISNT; 'blooming' is the floral sense, not the British mild curse.
explanation.definitionFit: A plant scientist is an expert in flowers and other plants, playfully described as blooming.

clue.text: Doubled up and bent to the oars as the stream got smaller

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the piece is read from bottom to top

parts.note: to double is to run at speed, as in 'at the double', so doubled gives ran
rowers bend to the oars, so this means rowed

explanation.surface: A rower, bent double, pulls hard as the river becomes narrower.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' turns RAN into NAR before ROWED is added; 'as the stream' sets the scene, so the definition is just 'got smaller'.
explanation.definitionFit: When a stream becomes less wide it is said to have tapered or contracted in width.

clue.text: A fish jelly

parts.note: the gar is a long-snouted freshwater fish

explanation.surface: A request for a fish in aspic.
explanation.definitionFit: Agar is a gelatinous substance from seaweed used as a setting agent.

clue.text: Famous runner having pains, about to be sick

indicators.note: the word for pains goes round the word for sick, so it is placed about it

parts.note: aches are pains
ill means sick

explanation.surface: A celebrated athlete is in pain and feels nauseous.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Famous runner' suggests a modern athlete, but it is the swift-footed Greek hero of the Iliad.
explanation.definitionFit: The Greek hero was renowned for his speed, called 'swift-footed' in Homer.

clue.text: Rugger sir?

parts.note: read as one who is a 'sir' of rugs: a rug is a carpet and a sir is a knight; also a derisive term for a soldier who stays home

explanation.surface: Addressing a rugby player respectfully.
explanation.walkthrough: Rugger is British slang for rugby union, but here it is read as 'rug-ger', something to do with rugs.
explanation.definitionFit: The term describes a knight dubbed at court rather than on the battlefield, kneeling on a carpet.

clue.text: South American in Central America

parts.note: CA is the abbreviation for Central America

explanation.surface: A person from the southern continent is in the isthmus region.
explanation.definitionFit: The Incas were a people of the Andes in South America.

clue.text: Toiler disposed to belie his reputation

definitions.text: Toiler disposed to belie his reputation

indicators.note: to dispose is to arrange, so the letters of the worker's word are set out afresh

explanation.surface: A hard worker inclined to contradict his good name.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue defines: a worker who idles is giving the lie to his name, and 'disposed' also rearranges TOILER.
explanation.definitionFit: To dawdle idly is the opposite of hard work, so a worker doing so contradicts his title.

clue.text: They cut out a silent warning to the listeners

parts.note: sh is a warning to keep silent
ears are what we listen with

explanation.surface: Someone hisses for quiet to an audience.
explanation.definitionFit: Large scissors used for cutting cloth, hedges or wool.

clue.text: Brown going to pitch a caber, is appropriately attired

indicators.note: the word for brown is added after the word for pitch

parts.note: tar is pitch
tan is a brown colour

explanation.surface: A Scot called Brown heads off to toss a caber in the Highland games.
explanation.walkthrough: The caber toss is a Scottish Highland games event, so the tosser is dressed in plaid; 'pitch' looks like a throw but gives TAR.
explanation.definitionFit: A Highland games competitor tossing a caber would traditionally wear a kilt of plaid cloth.

clue.text: Do put in the amount asked for professional work

indicators.note: the word for do is placed inside the word for the amount asked

parts.note: the price is what a seller asks
to do is to act

explanation.surface: An instruction to put in the sum requested for a job.
explanation.definitionFit: A doctor's or lawyer's business is called their practice.

clue.text: Troops which fall on the enemy

definitions.text: Troops which fall on the enemy

parts.words: Troops which fall on the enemy
parts.note: to fall on is to attack, but here the soldiers literally drop from the sky onto the foe

explanation.surface: Soldiers who launch an assault.
explanation.definitionFit: Airborne soldiers descend by canopy onto enemy territory.

clue.text: Light gas

definitions.meaning: a glowing tube sign used in advertising
an inert element of the noble group

explanation.definitionFit: It is both a lighting type in bright signs and a noble element in the air.

clue.text: Am led around. Apparently I need to be

indicators.note: the letters are moved around into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone is guided about, as if unable to walk unaided.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition follows the wordplay: a person who has to be led around is apparently crippled.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone crippled cannot walk alone and must be guided.

clue.text: An onlooker who looks ahead

definitions.meaning: a prophet who foresees the future

explanation.definitionFit: The word means literally one who sees, and also a prophet with visions of the future.

clue.text: Shoot a second intellectual snob

parts.note: a prig is a self-righteous, superior person

explanation.surface: Fire on a pompous highbrow a second time.
explanation.definitionFit: A small twig or stem growing from a plant.

clue.text: 500 carpets should make it possible to get quite high

definitions.text: make it possible to get quite high

parts.note: D is the Roman numeral for 500
rugs are small carpets

explanation.surface: A huge order of floor coverings lets you climb a long way.
explanation.walkthrough: 'get quite high' suggests stacking carpets, but means intoxication.
explanation.definitionFit: Narcotics are taken to become intoxicated.

clue.text: People who take steps with their eyes closed

definitions.text: People who take steps with their eyes closed

parts.words: People who take steps with their eyes closed
parts.note: taking steps sounds like acting blindly, but these walk while asleep

explanation.surface: Those who act without looking.
explanation.definitionFit: Somnambulists walk during slumber with eyes shut.

clue.text: The spycatcher litigation should be shelved

definitions.text: The spycatcher litigation should be shelved

parts.words: The spycatcher litigation should be shelved
parts.note: the 1980s government lawsuit over the memoir Spycatcher was a trial about a volume, and volumes are put on shelves

explanation.surface: The Spycatcher court battle ought to be dropped.
explanation.walkthrough: Spycatcher was a memoir by an ex-MI5 officer that the British government tried to ban in the 1980s; the dispute over it was a legal action about a volume.
explanation.definitionFit: Furniture with shelves where volumes are kept.

clue.text: Knave under 25 is an impudent fop

indicators.note: in a down clue the word for knave is placed below the other piece

parts.note: refers to the answer at 25-across, meaning miss out
the jack is the knave in a pack of cards

explanation.surface: A rogue lurks beneath number twenty-five.
explanation.definitionFit: An archaic term for a pert, conceited dandy.

clue.text: A game bird likely to crow over his achievements

definitions.text: A game bird likely to crow over his achievements

parts.words: A game bird likely to crow over his achievements
parts.note: a bird bred for combat, and one that boasts like a rooster after a win

explanation.surface: A boastful sportsman celebrating victory.
explanation.definitionFit: Birds bred for cockpit bouts, plucky and boastful.

clue.text: Preferably inform on the woman

parts.note: to rat is to inform on someone
her refers to a woman

explanation.surface: It is better to tell tales about her.
explanation.definitionFit: Means sooner or by choice, as in 'I would sooner'.

clue.text: Set course for the headwaters of the river

indicators.note: to set is to arrange, so the letters are put in a new order

explanation.surface: Navigators plot a route upstream.
explanation.definitionFit: The origin of a river is where it springs from.

clue.text: How to hail a small passenger boat

parts.note: a hoy is a small coastal vessel for passengers or goods

explanation.surface: Asking the way to signal a little ferry.
explanation.definitionFit: A sailor's call used to greet another vessel.

clue.text: That part of the switch you find irritating to the skin

indicators.note: only a part of the words is taken, the letters running across them

explanation.surface: A section of the cane you find stings.
explanation.definitionFit: Describes a fabric or rash that makes you want to scratch.

clue.text: Miss out advice light-footed lasses

definitions.meaning: an instruction to girls to hop along lightly

explanation.definitionFit: It means to omit, and also to move with light hops as nimble girls do.

clue.text: Maple is one producing unreturnable service

definitions.meaning: the botanical genus of the maple tree
a tennis player who serves an ace

explanation.definitionFit: It is the maple's genus name and, playfully, a server of aces.

clue.text: Quick, in fact the very quickest way to lose weight

definitions.text: the very quickest way to lose weight

explanation.definitionFit: It means rapid, and also to abstain from eating, a quick route to slimming.

clue.text: Anything but soft currency

parts.note: soft currency is a weak money; the opposite is firm, and actual money in hand

explanation.surface: Money that is strong and stable.
explanation.definitionFit: Ready money, notes and coins, rather than credit.

clue.text: Airline with a route between the Atlantic and Pacific

definitions.text: route between the Atlantic and Pacific

parts.note: Pan Am was a major US carrier

explanation.surface: An air carrier offering a link between two oceans.
explanation.definitionFit: The isthmus nation whose canal links two oceans.

clue.text: Fodder for the right variety of grey donkey

indicators.note: a variety is a different form, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: an ass is a donkey

explanation.surface: Feed suitable for a particular grey donkey.
explanation.walkthrough: 'variety of' rearranges GREY to YEGR, between R and ASS.
explanation.definitionFit: A grass grown as animal feed.

clue.text: Run out of habit

parts.note: suggests stopping a routine, but means running without clothing

explanation.surface: Breaking a custom.
explanation.definitionFit: To dash naked through a public place.
